statements.t: The positive reception and continued development progress across these projects reinforce our confidence in the commercial potential of our AAA pipeline.

As these highly anticipated titles continue advancing toward launch, industry events and community engagement initiatives remain important platforms to build momentum and provide players with greater visibility into our development progress.
We expect our recently released titles, together with the anticipated ARK: Dragontopia skyworld map in December, to support fourth quarter performance.
We expect a consistent roll out of new short film dramas.

While we believe we have a significant opportunity to grow our installed base, we anticipate that our overall user growth rate will fluctuate over time as we continue to release new master games and companion DLCs.

As our industry moves towards increased use of cloud gaming and gaming as a service technology, our ability to bring interactive technologies to market will be an increasingly important part of our business.
We have grown and expect to continue to grow our business by collaborating with game studios that we believe can benefit from our team’s decades of experience developing successful games.
As we expand to new markets, we anticipate similar relationships with additional distribution partners that could similarly impact our performance.
We anticipate this cadence will provide significant revenue visibility.
We introduced PixARK Worlds , a new title in development by Studio Sirens and Snail Games, created with guidance from Studio Wildcard, featuring revolutionary user-generated content designed.
We anticipate this consistent release cadence will provide significant and ongoing revenue visibility.

We anticipate that these major releases will contribute significantly to our near-term performance, with approximately $11.9 million from our deferred revenue backlog recognized in the third quarter of 2026.
In accordance with Nasdaq rules, we submitted a plan to the Staff to regain compliance (the “Compliance Plan”) with the Nasdaq Requirements on May 11, 2026.
On August 13, 2026, the Panel held a hearing at which we presented our plan to regain compliance with the Equity Rule.
Any compliance submission by us will be subject to review by the Panel.

There can be no assurance that the Panel will grant our request to further extend the exception period, or that we will satisfy the conditions of the Panel’s decision or otherwise regain compliance with the applicable listing requirements within such exception period, and a failure to do so would result in the delisting of our securities from Nasdaq.
We generally expect cost of revenues to fluctuate proportionately with revenues.
We expect salaries and wages to increase as we increase headcount when expanding our product offerings.

We expect general and administrative expenses will increase in absolute dollars due to the additional administrative and regulatory burden of becoming and operating as a public company and the inflationary pressures of recent years.
We expect our research and development to increase as we develop new content, games or technologies.
We plan to continue to invest in advertising and marketing to retain and acquire players.

When projected future cash flows were no longer expected to recover from the carrying value of film projects and game licenses, we recognize an impairment charge to write down the assets in full, or in part, to their estimated fair value.

The decrease in impairment of film assets was due to the Company’s underperformance of two films during the nine months ended September 30, 2026 compared to the underperformance of eight films and changes in the market conditions affecting expected future cash flow during the nine months ended September 30, 2025.
Our presentation of EBITDA should not be construed as an inference that our future results will be unaffected by unusual or unexpected items.
There is no guarantee we will receive a waiver from the applicable lender if the covenants of the loans are breached in the future.

We cannot provide assurance that we will be able to successfully access any such equity or debt financings, that the required equity or debt financings would be available on terms acceptable to us, if at all, or that any such financings would not be dilutive to our stockholders.

Our current unrestricted cash position of approximately $12.1 million, and our expected revenue receipts will allow the Company to continue operations beyond the next 12 months and service its current debts.

We fund our operations from our net cash flows provided by operating activities as well as through public and private sales of our securities, and we expect to continue to seek and obtain additional capital in a similar manner.
On and after March 31, 2027, we will no longer be permitted to borrow any further amounts under the Revolving Loan.

At such time, the revolving Loan will be converted to a term loan with maturity date of March 31, 2030, and we will be required to repay any principal balance then outstanding in monthly installments.
